category_edits.rationale: Retain the existing weighted ranking loss and add 0.1 times the mean pairwise logistic loss over the same valid positive-negative pairs. This directly penalizes ranking reversals without changing sampling, architecture, inference, or training settings.

edits.replace:
pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)
    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum() + 0.1 * pairwise_loss.mean()
